note: Greene County NY publishes no zoning district layer in its ArcGIS services (web map layers hold parcels, boundaries, flood, soils, districts, but no zoning; parcel layer has no zoning field). Towns zone separately: Cairo publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (2017); Catskill and Athens publish zoning code with map attachments on eCode360. No queryable zoning polygon service found for the county or its towns and villages.
